data.text:
Girdharee Ram vs Smt. Shubhra Singh (2024:Rj-Jd:41004) on 7
October, 2024
Author: Vinit Kumar Mathur 
Bench: Vinit Kumar Mathur
 [2024:Rj-Jd:41004]
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At 
 JODHPUR  S.B. Writ Contempt No. 324/2024  Girdharee Ram S/o Shri Kesha Ram, Aged About 52 Years  Bhana Nagar, Village and Post Dandli, District Barmer  
 Versus  1. Smt. Shubhra Singh, Additional Chief Secreta  Health And Family Welfare Department, Govern  Rajasthan, Jaipur (Raj.). 
 2. Shri Shivprasad Madan   Commissionerate Of Food Safety And Drug Cont  Rajasthan, Swastiya Bhawan, Commissionerate   And Drug Control Rajasthan, C Scheme, Ashok   Jaipur (Raj.).
 3. The State Of Rajasthan, Through The Principa  Medical, Health And Family  Government Of Rajasthan, Jaipur (Raj.).
 
 For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Sanjeet Puroh  For Respondent(s) :
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINIT KUMAR MATHUR Order 07/10/2024 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the compliance of the order passed by this Court has been made, therefore, nothing survives in the present contempt petition. 
Accordingly, the present contempt petition is dismissed as rendered infructuous. 
(VINIT KUMAR MATHUR),J 438-Shahenshah/-
